message: Dear Gopi, we saw your verified requirement for one 20ft container of dates to the Netherlands, including Ajwa, Medjool and other varieties. Seventh Sky Trade is an Iranian dates export company and we would like to check whether Iranian-origin date options are acceptable for this requirement. If yes, please share your preferred product profile, grade/size, carton format, destination port and target arrival date, and we can review suitable options subject to current availability and specifications. Best regards, Seventh Sky Trade
notes: Fresh verified RFQ dated 2026-08-17. Quantity is one 20ft container, CIF Netherlands, suppliers accepted worldwide. Payment terms shown are L/C or bank transfer after arrival; the latter creates seller credit risk, so L/C or another secure structure should be preferred. The named request is Ajwa/Medjool/etc., so Iranian varieties must be proposed only as alternatives after the buyer confirms origin and variety flexibility. This buyer also posted other same-day food import RFQs to the Netherlands, which is consistent with active procurement but should not be treated as proof of company identity. Score A due very recent verified container-scale requirement, open worldwide sourcing, and clear shipping/payment terms.
